concerns.text: T019 (Validate Training Set Size) depends on T020 (Load and Split Data) which is marked [ ] (incomplete). T019 must execute AFTER T020 produces the split files. The current order places the validation task before the data generation task, violating the producer-consumer dependency.

T029b (Retrain if Needed) is marked [ ] (incomplete) but is a prerequisite for T029c (Stable Model Fallback) and T028 (Permutation Importance). T028 explicitly depends on `random_forest_model_stable.pkl` which T029b must produce. The task list places T029b as incomplete, creating a broken chain where downstream tasks cannot execute.

T016a (Save engineered dataset) is marked [ ] (incomplete) but is the producer for T020 (Load and Split Data) and T016b (Validate processed data). T016b attempts to validate a file that T016a has not yet generated. The order must ensure T016a completes before T016b and T020.

T021 (Train RF & CV) and T022 (Test Set Evaluation) are marked [ ] (incomplete) but are required to produce `cv_metrics.json` and `random_forest_model.pkl` which T024a (Statistical Test) and T029a (Collinearity Detection) consume. The dependency flow is broken as consumers are listed before their producers are marked complete.

T022b (Null Model training) is marked [ ] (incomplete) but is a strict prerequisite for T024a (Null-Model Statistical Test). T024a loads `null_model_cv_scores.json` which T022b must generate. The current ordering implies T024a can run without T022b completing.

T008 (Ingestion Error Handling) is marked [ ] (incomplete) but is logically part of the ingestion logic in T012. While not a hard ordering violation, it should be grouped with T012 or explicitly noted as a sub-task to avoid confusion about the ingestion pipeline's readiness.
